seo.title: Staxx: Your Books, Ranked. Find Your Next Favorite.
seo.description: Staxx is a free book app for iPhone. Compare books head to head for scores that mean something, get picks predicted for your taste, and follow what your friends are reading.

hero.subtitle: Compare books head to head for scores that mean something. Get picks predicted for your taste. Follow what your friends are reading.
hero.availability: Free · App Store coming soon · Android coming soon

steps.title: Finish a book
steps.text: Mark it read, then say roughly how it landed: loved it, it was okay, or not for me.

steps.title: Pick between two
steps.text: A few quick head-to-heads against books you've already ranked. No stars, no second-guessing.

steps.title: Get a real score
steps.text: It slots into your ranked shelf with a score out of 10 that reflects how you actually felt.

features.title: Stars are too blunt. Comparisons aren't.
paragraphs: Was it a 4 or a 4.5? Nobody knows. But you always know which of two books you liked more. Staxx asks that a handful of times and works out exactly where the book belongs.
bullets: Separate ranked lists for fiction and non-fiction
About 7 questions, even with 100 books on your shelf

features.title: Know your score before you read the first page.
paragraphs: Every ranking teaches Staxx a little more about your taste: the styles, moods, and authors you keep coming back to. It predicts what you'd score books you haven't read yet.
Every book page shows how it compares with what you usually read: darker or cozier, slower or a page-turner, more romance or less.
The more you rank, the sharper it gets.

features.title: Browse by genre, sorted for you.
paragraphs: Tap a genre and every shelf re-sorts by your predicted score, so the best match for you is always first. Search any book, author, or reader in one place.
bullets: Popular new releases from the last six months
The books your friends loved most
Readers with taste like yours, to follow

features.title: See what your friends are reading, and how they ranked it.
paragraphs: Follow friends to see their rankings as they happen, browse their shelves, and find out who shares your taste. Their scores help predict yours, too.

faq.question: When can I get it?
faq.answer: Staxx is coming soon to the App Store. Join the waitlist and we'll email you when it's ready.

faq.question: Is Staxx on Android?
faq.answer: Android is coming soon. Join the waitlist and we'll let you know.

faq.question: How is my score worked out?
faq.answer: Your first answer puts the book in a band: loved it (6.7–10), it was okay (3.4–6.6) or not for me (0–3.3). The head-to-heads place it within that band, so a book you loved always scores like one.

faq.question: Do I have to compare against my whole library?
faq.answer: No. Each answer halves the options, so it's about 7 questions with 100 books, and you can call any pair too close to call.

closing.text: Be first to rank your shelf. We'll email you the day Staxx arrives.
